tests.name: gen_21

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise is_std_contiguous_byte_iterator_impl specialization for std::string::const_iterator by querying the trait directly and parsing through iterator_input_adapter_factory.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise the trait and factory with std::vector<signed char>::const_iterator to ensure signed char specialized paths are fully instantiated.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise the trait and factory with std::vector<unsigned char>::iterator to ensure unsigned char specialized paths are fully instantiated.
